name: io.github.everxcloud/mcp
title: EverXCloud GPU prices
description: Read-only EverXCloud GPU cloud data: live hourly GPU rental prices, GPU catalog, how to rent.

tools.name: list_gpu_prices
tools.description: Live hourly rental prices of EverXCloud cloud GPUs in USD (full GPUs and GPU shares), with the region and a link to rent. All filters are optional.

gpu.description: GPU name or part of it, case-insensitive, e.g. "4090", "B300"

type.description: "full" for a whole GPU, "share" for a GPU slice

tools.name: get_gpu_price
tools.description: Hourly from-price of one GPU model on EverXCloud, per region and rental type (full GPU or GPU share), with a link to rent.

tools.name: list_gpu_models
tools.description: The EverXCloud GPU catalog: model name, VRAM, architecture and vendor, with a details link.

tools.name: how_to_rent
tools.description: How to sign up and rent a GPU on EverXCloud: portal link, rental modes, API key documentation.
